summary: WI-06f builds the section 26 bathymetry map overlay as one independently testable behavior: a Tab-bound UI overlay that pauses the game and renders existing state (player position, explored chunk silhouettes from discoveredChunks, base, discovered major landmarks from WI-04b, optional death beacon) while structurally excluding creature locations via a read-only data model. One named subsystem (UI overlays and settings); the stale WI-15 comment cleanup is part of the same overlay landing. AC-art-map carried verbatim from ST-06; WI-06f is sole owner and final proof owner. Dependency on WI-04b is correct (landmark ids and discovery state). Evidence is focused: browser checks for toggle/pause/contents/no-creature-markers/beacon-absence, plus a Node test asserting the data model exposes no creature fields. Boundaries are clean: read-only presentation, no new simulation rules, no save-schema change, no creature tracking. Handoff names specific files and constraints; a fresh implementer can proceed without reconstructing the project.
